shapes.name: Palestine
shapes.note: Occupied by Israel since 1967 (International Court of Justice advisory opinion, 19 July 2024)

shapes.name: Somalia
shapes.note: Self-declared independent since 1991, not recognised by any UN member

shapes.name: Georgia
shapes.note: Out of Georgia's control since the 1992-1993 war; recognised by Russia and a few states only

source.title: Timor-Leste (Wikipedia)
source.what: East Timor becomes independent as Timor-Leste

shapes.name: Moldova
shapes.note: Self-declared state since 1990, held with Russian troops since the 1992 war, recognised by no UN member. Drawn from the Natural Earth districts east of the Dniester and Bender, which it holds

shapes.name: Cyprus
shapes.note: Held by Turkish forces since 1974; declared independent in 1983, recognised only by Turkey (UN Security Council resolutions 541 and 550)

shapes.name: Ukraine
shapes.note: Annexed by Russia in 2014, not recognised (UN General Assembly resolution 68/262)

shapes.name: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
shapes.wikipedia: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

source.title: São Tomé and Príncipe (Wikipedia)
source.what: São Tomé and Príncipe becomes independent

shapes.name: Mauritius
shapes.note: Held by the United Kingdom as the British Indian Ocean Territory; the UN General Assembly (resolution 73/295, 2019) recognises it as part of Mauritius

shapes.name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
shapes.wikipedia: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

shapes.name: Syria
shapes.note: Occupied by Israel since 1967 and annexed in 1981, not recognised (UN Security Council resolution 497)

shapes.name: Western Sahara
shapes.note: Held by Morocco west of its sand wall since Spain left in 1976; a non-self-governing territory on the UN list, its status still to be settled
